cases.in: Ta ütles: "Mul on igav." ja läks.
cases.out: Ta ütles: „Mul on igav.“ ja läks.
cases.note: EKI, Eesti keele õigekirja põhireeglid R37: low-opening „ and 66-shaped closing “; the full stop of direct speech stays inside.

cases.in: Ta ütles: "Õpetaja ütles: "Ega hinne parane." Mis siis?"
cases.out: Ta ütles: „Õpetaja ütles: „Ega hinne parane.“ Mis siis?“
cases.note: Põhireeglid R38 Märkus 1 and R51 Märkus 2: a quotation inside a quotation takes the same pair; the same pair at both levels is the pin.

cases.in: Ta ütles: "See on 'tsitaat' raamatust" ja läks.
cases.out: Ta ütles: „See on „tsitaat“ raamatust“ ja läks.
cases.note: Põhireeglid R51 Märkus 2 permits a nested quotation; no read source uses single marks, so single straight inner quotes become the same pair (a pin).
Põhireeglid R37: text already carrying U+201E/U+201C is a fixed point.
Raadik, Keelenõuanne soovitab 5, p. 227: ÕS 2013 abandoned the „…” form; a U+201D closer typed by the author is normalised to the pinned U+201C.
« » is ranked second by EVS 8:2008 (Raadik, Keelenõuanne soovitab 5, p. 227); it is normalised to the pinned pair.
Põhireeglid examples are closed: innerSpace is none.
ACCEPTED COST of the identical pair: a nest whose inner mark touches the outer one is declined (quotes.md §6, §3.2 V1); the inner apostrophe-shaped mark is left to the apostrophe rule.
ACCEPTED COST of the identical pair: the nest opens against the outer opener, so it is declined (quotes.md §6, §3.2 V1).
Three dots become the ellipsis character (Põhireeglid R56, mõttepunktid).
Raadik, Märgikobarad (Oma Keel 2/2022) p. 54: «huvitavatki?…» keeps the dots after the question mark, so abbreviatedAfterTerminal is false.
Raadik, Märgikobarad p. 55: «Küsi- ja hüüumärk säilivad ning lause lõpus võivad nad olla nii mõttepunktide ees kui ka järel»; p. 56 «kurat!…». No two-dot form after «!» is attested.
Mäekivi, Raadik, Keelenõuanne soovitab 4, p. 194; Põhireeglid R53–54: en dash with a space on both sides.
ESA vormistusnõuded: the en dash is the dash in a sentence; an em dash is normalised by this pin (no read source excludes U+2014).
An en dash already in place is a fixed point.
Mäekivi, Raadik 2008 p. 195: «1986–1989», en dash, no spaces; the en-tight form carries U+2060 either side (ranges.md §3).
An en dash already between digits is left as it is (ranges.md §3).
A hyphen between words is not a range (ranges.md §3).
Põhireeglid R59–61: no closed list of unbreakable forms, so the hyphen rule changes nothing.

cases.in: Maksab 15 € ja 3 km ja 10 kg ja 25 cm ja 7 ha ja –6 °C
cases.out: Maksab 15 € ja 3 km ja 10 kg ja 25 cm ja 7 ha ja –6 °C
cases.note: Põhireeglid R36: «30 g, 15 €, –6 °C»; Rehemaa p. 26: number and unit stay on one line.

cases.in: 5 m ja 3 g ja 7 a laps
cases.out: 5 m ja 3 g ja 7 a laps
cases.note: Single-letter units are excluded by DECISION (they are also common words; nbsp.md §3.7); ACCEPTED COST: «4 m», «7 a» stay unbound.
Põhireeglid R36 Märkus 2: «9%, 0,4‰» are written closed; closedUnits deletes the space.
nbsp.md §3.7: the unit is in spacedUnits, so the missing space is inserted as U+00A0.

cases.in: See on k.a ja v.a ja nt ja jne
cases.out: See on k.a ja v.a ja nt ja jne
cases.note: Mäekivi, Raadik p. 193 and Põhireeglid R63 Märkus 1: Estonian abbreviations carry no internal space, so abbreviations is empty and nothing is bound.
The space is attested (Mäekivi, Raadik p. 192; Rehemaa p. 28) but no read source makes it non-breaking, so beforeNumber is empty.

cases.in: F. R. Kreutzwald ja A. Värnik
cases.out: F. R. Kreutzwald ja A. Värnik
cases.note: Mäekivi, Raadik p. 192 attests the space after an initial but not its non-breaking form, so initialBinding is none.

Mäekivi, Raadik, Keelenõuanne soovitab 4, p. 191: «Koma, punkti, kooloni, semikooloni, küsimärgi ja hüüumärgi ette lauses tühikut ei panda»; nbsp.beforePunctuation is empty, so the space is removed, not bound.
Spaces inside brackets and before a full stop are removed.
(c) becomes the copyright sign.
Põhireeglid R57 and Märkus 4: a straight apostrophe becomes U+2019.
Põhireeglid R37 vs R38; Raadik, «Kuidas vormistada tsitaati?», KS5 p. 218: placement depends on meaning, so punctuationPlacement is none and the rule leaves the text alone.
